name: Browse and persist a real cart
description: Verifies database-backed products can be browsed, added and retained after reload.
expected: Aero Knit Runner remains in the bag with its quantity preserved.

name: Create and edit a product in CMS
description: Verifies the CMS creates a real record from entered values and updates the same record instead of inserting dummy content.
steps: Enter a unique product name, price, category, image and description
expected: The edited product remains with the changed values and the CMS contains no automatically generated demo record.

name: Create and edit a coupon rule
description: Verifies coupon rules are persistent server records and remain editable.
steps: Enter a unique code, type, value and expiry
expected: The same coupon remains present with its edited value.

name: Edit live storefront content on mobile
description: Verifies the storefront copy is editable from the CMS and the management interface works on a narrow viewport.
steps: Change the announcement and hero body
expected: The edited announcement and hero body are visible and the mobile UI has no horizontal overflow.

name: Secure order lifecycle and self-service recovery
description: Verifies a customer can complete payment, see the durable order, cancel an unpaid order, or request a refund after payment without exposing another customer's order.
steps: Add Aero Knit Runner to the bag
Use the refund action on the paid order
expected: The paid order appears once, refunding it changes the order to Refunded, inventory is restored, and the operation is recorded in the server audit log.
